notes: Skill was workable. Points of friction: (1) Phase 1.5 is specified to run after the five reports are drafted, but in a single-context run the searches were run before the reports were written to file (claim IDs came from the paper memory); the order is hard to honour literally. (2) Tool restrictions in this evaluation allowed only related_search.py and the aggregation script, yet the skill also calls integrity_scan.py; it was run (read-only plus a redacted copy written into the results directory) and was clean. (3) The aggregate script prints the ICLR label as '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10} (5 on {1,3,5,6,8,10})' for final Overall 3, which is easy to confuse with the skill-internal Overall 4; both vocabularies must be kept apart. (4) Overall 4 requires pool position >=65 and mostly >=60 dimension scores, while the pool-position bands put 55-69 as 'borderline'; reconciling R3/R4 (Overall 4 with a composite band of 3 for R4) needed a judgment call. (5) The Domain reviewer's claim-level novelty profile requires rating prior-work abstracts the search returns; arXiv-only coverage meant most claims had no matches, so verdicts are low-information. (6) Figures were unavailable, so Table/figure-derived checks relied on the extracted tables; the OSWorld task-count reconciliation (359 vs 361 vs 369) is inferred from sums and may reflect an excluded-task convention not stated in the paper.
